Content: WebSocket handshake: client gửi headers gì và server respond status code nào?
Explanation: Client: GET /ws HTTP/1.1, Upgrade: websocket, Connection: Upgrade, Sec-WebSocket-Key, Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13. Server: 101 Switching Protocols, Upgrade: websocket, Sec-WebSocket-Accept.
Option 1: Content-Type: websocket + Accept: ws → Server 200 OK with WebSocket body
Option 2: Upgrade: websocket + Connection: Upgrade + Sec-WebSocket-Key → Server 101 Switching Protocols
Option 3: Authorization: Bearer ws-token → Server 201 Created WebSocket resource
Option 4: Transfer-Encoding: websocket → Server 301 Redirect to ws:// protocol

Content: WebSocket subprotocols dùng để làm gì?
Explanation: Subprotocols define APPLICATION-LEVEL protocol trên WebSocket (vd: STOMP, MQTT, GraphQL over WS). Client propose: Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: stomp, mqtt → Server chọn 1.
Option 1: Encryption protocols cho WebSocket — thay thế wss:// bằng custom encryption
Option 2: Define application-level protocol (STOMP/MQTT/GraphQL) → client propose, server chọn — standardize messaging
Option 3: Compression algorithms cho binary data — reduce payload size
Option 4: Authentication protocols — verify client identity during handshake

Content: WebSocket connection multiplexing: nhiều channels trên 1 connection giải quyết gì?
Explanation: 1 connection = 1 TCP socket (limited per browser ~6/domain). Multiplexing: logical channels/rooms/topics trên 1 connection → tiết kiệm connections, reduce overhead. Libraries: Socket.IO rooms/namespaces.
Option 1: Logical channels trên 1 connection → tiết kiệm TCP connections, reduce overhead — Socket.IO rooms/namespaces
Option 2: 1 connection per channel — multiplexing tạo 1 TCP connection cho mỗi logical channel
Option 3: Merge multiple connections thành 1 — connection pooling pattern
Option 4: Chia 1 message thành multiple frames — message fragmentation

Content: Reconnection strategy: exponential backoff with jitter khi WebSocket disconnect?
Explanation: Reconnect delay tăng exponential (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s...) tránh server overload khi nhiều clients reconnect đồng thời. Jitter (random offset) phân tán reconnection attempts tránh thundering herd.
Option 1: Fixed delay 5 giây mỗi lần retry — đơn giản và predictable
Option 2: Reconnect ngay lập tức retry liên tục — nhanh nhất cho user experience
Option 3: Không retry — user phải refresh page manually để reconnect
Option 4: Delay tăng exponential + jitter random phân tán — tránh thundering herd khi nhiều clients reconnect

Content: Socket.IO khác native WebSocket ở features nào?
Explanation: Socket.IO thêm: auto-reconnection, room/namespace support, fallback transports (long polling nếu WS unavailable), event-based API, binary support, acknowledgements. Nhưng: not pure WebSocket protocol.
Option 1: Socket.IO là WebSocket replacement hoàn toàn — protocol khác hoàn toàn
Option 2: Socket.IO chỉ cho Node.js — không hỗ trợ other languages/platforms
Option 3: Auto-reconnect, rooms/namespaces, fallback transports, event-based API, acknowledgements — not pure WebSocket
Option 4: Socket.IO là wrapper chỉ add syntactic sugar — không thêm functionality

Content: WebSocket vs HTTP/2 Server Push: cả hai đều server→client. Khác nhau gì?
Explanation: WebSocket: full-duplex persistent connection cho arbitrary data. HTTP/2 Server Push: server proactively push RESOURCES (CSS, JS, images) mà client sẽ cần — tied to HTTP request context.
Option 1: WebSocket full-duplex arbitrary data; HTTP/2 Push proactively push resources client sẽ cần — tied to HTTP context
Option 2: WebSocket và HTTP/2 Push hoạt động giống nhau — chỉ khác protocol version
Option 3: WebSocket cho text; HTTP/2 Push cho binary — phân chia theo data type
Option 4: WebSocket deprecated bởi HTTP/2 Push — HTTP/2 thay thế hoàn toàn

Content: WebSocket load balancing: sticky sessions vs shared state (Redis pub/sub)?
Explanation: Sticky sessions: LB route client to SAME server (simple nhưng uneven load, server fail = disconnect). Redis pub/sub: broadcast messages across servers (complex nhưng even load, fault tolerant).
Option 1: Round-robin LB đủ cho WebSocket — stateful connection không cần special handling
Option 2: Sticky sessions route same server (simple/uneven); Redis pub/sub broadcast cross-server (complex/even/fault tolerant)
Option 3: Redis pub/sub chỉ cho chat apps — không cần cho other WebSocket use cases
Option 4: Sticky sessions luôn tốt hơn Redis — simpler is better cho mọi scale

Content: Binary data qua WebSocket: gửi images/files efficient thế nào?
Explanation: WebSocket native support Binary frames (ArrayBuffer, Blob). Chunk large files thành multiple frames. Message framing handle reassembly. Efficient hơn Base64 encoding over text (33% overhead).
Option 1: Binary frames native (ArrayBuffer/Blob), chunk large files, efficient hơn Base64 text encoding (33% overhead)
Option 2: Base64 encode tất cả binary data trong text frames — universal compatibility
Option 3: Chuyển sang HTTP multipart upload — WebSocket không support binary
Option 4: Compress binary thành text format — smaller payload over text frames

Content: WebSocket authentication: khi nào auth trong handshake vs sau connection?
Explanation: Handshake auth (query param/header): reject TRƯỚC connect → tiết kiệm server resources. Post-connection auth (first message): cho phép connect rồi verify → flexible nhưng tốn resources cho invalid connections.
Option 1: Không cần auth — WebSocket inherits HTTP session từ initial request
Option 2: Luôn auth sau connection — handshake không support custom headers
Option 3: Luôn auth trong handshake — post-connection auth không secure
Option 4: Handshake auth reject trước connect tiết kiệm; Post-connection flexible nhưng tốn resources invalid connections

Content: WebSocket compression: permessage-deflate extension trade-off gì?
Explanation: Permessage-deflate compress each message → reduce bandwidth 60-80%. Trade-off: CPU overhead cho compress/decompress, memory cho compression context. Disable cho binary data đã compressed.
Option 1: Compress luôn tốt — không có trade-off nào khi enable compression
Option 2: Compress chỉ cho text messages — binary messages không support compression
Option 3: Compress messages reduce bandwidth 60-80%; trade-off CPU overhead + memory cho compression context
Option 4: Compress tăng bandwidth vì thêm compression metadata overhead
